title: AML Trust Registry v1
description: External, authoritative trust registry (spec section 6). One entry binds (institution_id, key_id) to a raw Ed25519 public key (base64 of 32 bytes). Lifecycle: active; retired (accepted only with an external trusted_time inside the validity window; a date read from inside a ZIP is never trusted_time); revoked (revoked_at recorded, always invalid); compromised (invalidates signatures with trusted_time >= invalid_from; a missing invalid_from invalidates EVERY signature of that key). Verifiers fail closed on missing keys or an unavailable registry.

base64Raw32.description: base64 (standard alphabet) of exactly 32 raw bytes (an Ed25519 public key).

invalid_from.description: Compromise horizon for status=compromised. Required to be non-null for compromised entries; verifiers treat a compromised entry without invalid_from as invalidating all of that key's signatures.
